messages:
maria: quick sync on how we should fan out v1 deprecation signals — trying to avoid noisy dashboards + sudden routing flips. thinking a staged signal. anyone have concerns?

aj: love staged signals. what's the intended effect per stage?

maria: high level: stage=trace (very light), stage=notice (visible in console/dashboards), stage=enforce (affects routing/quotas). keep billing/metering untouched until enforce.

kevin: current behavior reminder: we tag requests with deprecated=true and console shows a generic banner. when header absent routing sometimes drops pins. that surprise is what we want to avoid.

sarah: propose sampling ramp for trace stage: start at 0.5% per-tenant, then to 5%, then 100% before escalate. traces should include labels: api_version, deprec_stage, tenant_id, route_hash (only when high-volume to avoid card explosion).

maria: important: metrics must remain joinable to billing keys. so keep canonical token label for metering. telemetry labels should be additive, not replace meter tags.

kevin: metric naming idea: `redwood.deprec.stage.count` with labels {stage, api_version, tenant_id, route_bucket}. route_bucket is coarse: a hashed bucket or `other`. avoids thousands of route labels.

sarah: pseudo for emission:```\nif (request.hasHeader("X-Client-Version") && request.clientVersion == "v1") {\n  if (rand() < traceSampleRate) {\n    telemetry.emit("redwood.deprec.stage", {\n      api_version: "v1",\n      deprec_stage: "trace",\n      deprec_sample: "true",\n      tenant_id: request.tenant(),\n      route_bucket: routeBucketFor(request.route())\n    })\n  }\n}\n```

aj: also: add a tiny trace sampling override for trace-stage so we occasionally capture full spans (0.05% of trace signals). otherwise we get counts but no root cause.

maria: console UX ideas: trace -> subtle info pill (no action), notice -> banner + endpoint list with counts, enforce -> warning + toggle to opt-out per-tenant. support can flip opt-out.

kevin: routing behavior for enforce stage: instead of immediate unpin/unroute, set a soft eviction TTL (e.g., 10m) and emit a tenant-level console alert with a "defer for 24h" button. this prevents hot flips.

sarah: rollout plan: gated behind `deprec_fanout_v1` flag. Phases: alpha (internal tenants) -> beta (small customer cohort) -> wide. sample rates per phase: 0.5% -> 5% -> 100% for trace; notice goes live in beta; enforce only for cohort in wide if signals stable.

aj: monitoring guardrails: automatically revert enforce for a tenant if error-rate > baseline+1% or latency p95 increases by >30ms within 30m window. also track console-alert churn metric.

maria: telemetry retention: keep stage metrics 30d; keep trace traces 7d. don't over-retain breadcrumb traces.

kevin: cardinality mitigation: only attach real `route_bucket` when route accounts for >1% of tenant traffic in the last 24h, else tag `route_bucket=other`. that keeps dashboards useful without explosion.

sarah: dashboards: add filter dropdown for `deprec_stage` and a small explanation panel. also create a columnar panel showing per-stage counts and percent of tenant traffic. will include a Grafana JSON with PR.

aj: operational hooks: Support can add tenant opt-out via admin API `POST /admin/tenants/:id/deprec-optout` which sets `enforce_disabled=true`. Ensure this is audited and triggers an event to telemetry.

maria: docs/copy: trace -> "Weve observed some v1 requests. This helps us measure migration progress." notice -> "A significant portion of your calls are still v1. Update clients or contact support." enforce -> "We will start applying routing/quotas to encourage migration. Click to opt-out."

kevin: one more: make console banners link to a per-tenant impact page that lists affected routes and a quick migration checklist. reduces support volume.

sarah: I'll open two PRs: (1) telemetry instrumentation + route bucketing util, (2) console copy + banners + per-tenant page stub.

maria: sounds good. aj, can you own feature flag rollout plan and guardrails?

aj: yep, will draft flag rollout doc with timelines and rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `feature/deprec-fanout-v1` -> staging 2026-03-23T04:00Z

maria: thanks team. I'll put together the RFC linking Sarah's PRs and Aj's rollout plan and assign reviewers.

kevin: no blockers from infra side.

aj: thumbs up.

sarah: PRs opened shortly.
